<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in Tajikistan]], [[List of terrorist incidents linked to ISIL#2018|Terrorist incidents linked to ISIL]]
**[[Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for an attack in [[Tajikistan]] that occurred two days prior and left four cycling tourists dead. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/isis-claims-tajikistan-attack-cyclists-2-americans-dead-tajiks-blame-islamists/ (CBS News)]
*[[Malian presidential election, 2018]]
**Gunmen attack a convoy carrying election materials in the [[Ségou Region]]. The attack and the ensuing shootout kill four soldiers and eight attackers. [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/deadly-attack-on-mali-election-convoy (SBS News)]
*Three people are killed and robbed in an ambush near [[Sibut]], [[Central African Republic]]. The [[Mikhail Khodorkovsky]]-financed ''Investigations Management Center'' says that they were [[Russia]]n journalists who worked with them on a documentary about [[Wagner Group]] mercenaries and Russian mining interests in the country. [http://tass.com/world/1015560 (TASS)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-centralafrica-violence/three-european-journalists-killed-in-central-africa-republic-ambush-idUSKBN1KL2DX (Reuters)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/russian-reporters-killed-central-african-republic-vladimir-putin-mikhail-khodorkovsky/ (CBS News)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**[[2018 Lamitan bombing]]
***A van loaded with an [[improvised explosive device]] explodes in an army checkpoint in [[Lamitan, Basilan|Lamitan]], [[Basilan]], in the Philippines, killing 11. [https://news.mb.com.ph/2018/07/31/basilan-van-blast-kills-11/ (''Manila Bulletin'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**Worker pay rate in the United States hits its highest level since 2008 according to the [[Bureau of Labor Statistics]]. The [[Employment Cost Index]], which tracks worker compensation, has been steadily increasing since just prior to [[Donald Trump]] taking office. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/07/31/worker-pay-rate-hits-highest-level-since-2008.html (CNBC)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-07-31/u-s-employment-costs-increase-from-year-ago-by-most-since-2008 (Bloomberg)] [https://www.bls.gov/news.release/eci.htm (Bureau of Labor Statistics)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 California wildfires]]
**Fires across [[California]] kill at least eight people. One month into the fiscal year, the state's emergency fund is about one quarter spent. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2018/07/31/8-dead-California-resource-strained-as-17-fires-ravage-state/2021533034087/ (UPI)]
*[[Aeroméxico Connect Flight 2431]]
**An [[Aeroméxico]] [[Embraer 190]] crashes shortly after taking off from [[Durango International Airport]] in [[Durango]], [[Mexico]], injuring around 85 people, two critically. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45027112 (BBC)]
*In [[Peru]], two trains collide en route to [[Machu Picchu]], injuring 15. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45030532 (BBC)]
*[[Popocatépetl]], a [[stratovolcano]] that is part of the [[Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt]], releases a large quantity of ash. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45018180 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Russia–European Union relations]]
**The [[European Union]] imposes sanctions on six [[List of companies of Russia|Russian companies]] involved in the construction of [[Crimean Bridge (Crimea)|the bridge]] connecting mainland [[Russia]] to the [[annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation|annexed]] [[Crimea]] peninsula. [https://themoscowtimes.com/news/eu-sanctions-6-russian-firms-over-crimea-bridge-62392 (''The Moscow Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]], [[Trials of Paul Manafort]]
**The former campaign chairman of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], [[Paul Manafort]], appears in court for the opening day of his criminal trial on 18 bank and fraud charges brought by special counsel [[Robert Mueller]]. [http://thehill.com/homenews/news/399707-manafort-appears-in-court-as-trial-kicks-off (''The Hill'')]
*A shooting at a [[billiard hall]] in [[El Tarra]], [[Colombia]], kills nine people. Local media blames a feud between two left-wing rebel groups, who both deny responsibility. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45018174 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Facebook]] announces that it has suspended 32 accounts it believes intended to influence the [[2018 United States elections|2018 mid-term elections]] in the [[United States]]. The company says while it is uncertain who operated these accounts, at least one is linked to the [[Russia]]n-based [[Internet Research Agency]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-45018516 (BBC)]

;Sports
*In baseball, the [[New York Mets]] suffer the worst loss in franchise history after being defeated by the [[Washington Nationals]], 25–4. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/mlb/2018/07/31/nationals-rout-mets-historic-offense/877095002/ (''USA Today'')]
